payload.title: P4-15: Pretext width cache is not cleared after web fonts load, so some loads wrap with fallback widths
payload.description: Found by the Threat Intelligence scaffold (P4-04, Threat-Intelligence#10): with Google-loaded fonts (brand fonts slot, Papyrus#150) the Pretext text measurement races the font load. Papyrus never clears Pretext width cache once the fonts are ready, so some page loads wrap lines with fallback-font widths and clip lines (edition height 17328 px vs 17648 px baseline when fonts load in time). Fix in Papyrus (lib/pretext-layout.ts, hooks use-brand-fonts-ready.ts and the rhythm overlay/blog presentation): when document.fonts reports the brand fonts ready (or a font loads), clear Pretext measurement caches and re-run layout; make it deterministic (no race), with tests, and verify against the P4-01 baseline (/Users/home/Projects/.baselines/threat-intelligence-20261007/) at 390/768/1280 px: heights equal on every load.
